:::{#def-matrix-transpose}
#### Matrix transpose

The **transpose** of an $m \times n$ matrix $\matr{A}$
is the $n \times m$ matrix $\tp{\matr{A}}$ obtained by
swapping the rows and columns of $\matr{A}$:

$$(\tp{\matr{A}})_{ij} = a_{ji}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-matrix-transpose}
#### Transposing a $2 \times 3$ matrix

$$
\tp{\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}}
= \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 4 \\ 2 & 5 \\ 3 & 6 \end{bmatrix},
$$

a $3 \times 2$ matrix. For instance, entry $(1, 2)$ of the transpose is $a_{21} = 4$.

:::
